chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Short FRQ (5 points) — Set 1: total surplus, price controls & international trade
chunks.content: AP Microeconomics FRQ 2 (Short), 5 points, one per element, including a calculation. Set 1 answer key highlights: calculate total economic surplus as $270 and SHOW WORK; state there will be neither a surplus nor a shortage and explain that a price is set at equilibrium (or a non-binding control); state that Rushland will export rice and explain (world price above domestic price, so domestic quantity supplied exceeds quantity demanded). Common failure: calculation without shown work; stating export/import without the world-price-vs-domestic-price reasoning; confusing binding vs. non-binding price controls.

chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 5/5 — calculated total surplus as $270 with shown work, stated no surplus/shortage with the equilibrium explanation, and stated Rushland exports rice with the world-price reasoning. Full-credit model.

chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 4/5 — earned most elements but lost one, commonly an explain point or the shown work on the surplus calculation. Illustrates a strong short-FRQ response one point short.

chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 2/5 — earned about two elements (e.g., one state point and a partial calculation), losing the explanations and the trade reasoning. Illustrates a low response that cannot complete the calculation or the trade logic.
